basis: Two questions, judged separately per Lilly. (1) Irish forces: the King is signified by the Moon in Cancer in the tenth, in her own house, increasing in light and void of all infelicity except slowness of motion = the King himself is strong and his design proceeds, only slowly. Aid is the eleventh house: its lord the Sun is posited in the seventh in his exaltation, applying to the cusp of the eleventh but wanting six degrees of being partile, and in direct opposition to the Ascendant (Parliament) = assistance of real dignity is on its way to its own house and is aimed directly against Parliament, but the six wanting degrees say it is not yet perfected — forces will be procured out of Ireland, after a delay measured by those degrees, and directed to Parliament's harm. (2) The Queen: her significatrix Saturn, lord of the fourth (seventh from the tenth), is removing out of one sign into another and entering Aries, his fall = she will advance (change of sign = change of place/advance) but into her fall, so she will not prosper in the advance; the Moon (the King) wanting only three or four degrees of the trine of Saturn (the Queen) perfects their meeting by a friendly aspect in three to four units of time. Net: procurement yes (delayed), advance yes, prosperity no, meeting yes — hence mixed.
prediction_text: (1) The King will procure forces out of Ireland to the Parliament's harm — the Sun, lord of the eleventh (aid), exalted in the seventh and applying to his own cusp in opposition to the Ascendant, promises real assistance aimed at Parliament — but not at once: he wants six degrees of partile, so the Irish aid comes only after delay. (2) The Queen will advance from the North, but Saturn her significatrix passing into Aries, his fall, shows she will not prosper in it; and she will meet the King, the Moon (his significator, strong in Cancer in the tenth) wanting but three or four degrees of a trine to Saturn — a meeting in about three to four months.
timing: Month scale, split by sub-question: Irish forces — window of about six months (six degrees wanting to partile), main coordinate c. six months; the royal meeting — window of three to four months (Moon 3–4 degrees short of Saturn's trine), main coordinate c. three to four months
